Asset type: production RGBA animation sprite atlas for ONE civilian thug/lookout in a small hand-painted top-down 2D game.

Dark charcoal worn sleeveless work vest/open casual jacket over muted gray tee, plain dull brown work trousers, sturdy dark work boots.
